expectations.text: Output has a valid SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter containing name and description
expectations.evidence: SKILL.md frontmatter has name: hubspot-slack-weekly-digest and a full description with triggering phrases and negative scope.

expectations.text: Names HubSpot and Slack as connectors by name only — no API keys, tokens, or credential values anywhere in the output

expectations.text: States an explicit success bar distinguishing a good run from a technically-complete one
expectations.evidence: 'The bar this replaces: 45 minutes of manual copy-pasting that regularly missed a deal or two. Good = zero missed deals, a mechanical reconciliation, not a prettier report.'

expectations.text: Names at least one concrete failure mode (e.g. missing RevOps Slack post, HubSpot auth failure, zero closed-won deals)

expectations.text: Includes a delegation plan (primary vs. sub-agent execution per step)
expectations.evidence: Delegation table delegates HubSpot fetch + RevOps extraction (parallel, independent), keeps reconciliation/composition/posting on the primary agent, with full 4-field contracts.
